```{r}

lowerTriangle <- function(m){
  return(m[lower.tri(m)])
}

cor_matrix_plot = function(data,range){
    options(repr.plot.width=10, repr.plot.height=10)
    corrplot(data,is.corr=FALSE,
             tl.pos="n", method = "color",
             #col.lim = range,
             cl.ratio = 0.05,
             col = gray(100:0/100)
             #col = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(n=7,name ="RdBu")))(100)
            )
}
```


# Human Rating data
## FAVEE Model
```{r}
human_123r_rating = read.csv('human_rating_data/dim_rel_scaled_33d.csv',row.names = 1, fileEncoding = 'gb18030')
rels_order_modern_123r = rownames(human_123r_rating)

# FAVEE model: favee
favee_123r_pc=read.csv('human_rating_data/human_model/human_123r_favee.csv',row.names=1, fileEncoding = 'gb18030') 
favee_123r_pc <- favee_123r_pc[, 1:5] 
#colnames(favee_258r_pc) = paste0(colnames(favee_258r_pc),'.modern')
favee_123r_pc_dist = as.matrix(-dist(favee_123r_pc,method='euclidean'))
favee_123r =  c(-dist(favee_123r_pc,method='euclidean'))
max(favee_123r_pc_dist)
min(favee_123r_pc_dist)

# single dimension model: pcsdv

ns <- length(favee_123r_pc)
pcsds_123r <- list()
pcsdv_123r = data.frame(matrix(nrow = 123*122/2, ncol=5))
colnames(pcsdv_123r) = colnames(favee_123r_pc)
for (i in 1:5){
    pcsds_123r[[i]]<-as.matrix((-dist(favee_123r_pc[,i])))
    pcsdv_123r[[i]] = c(-dist(favee_123r_pc[,i])) # take proximities on each dimension
}
names(pcsds_123r) = colnames(favee_123r_pc)
```

```{r}
bert_emb_modern = read.csv('sim_bert_embedding/modern/q3.1_bert_embedding_data/MASK_embedding_output.csv',
                   row.names = 1, check.names = FALSE, fileEncoding = 'gb18030')

                                                          ))
```

```{r}
# ancient
bert_emb_ancient = read.csv('sim_bert_embedding/ancient/q3.2_bert_embedding_data/MASK_embedding_output.csv', check.names = FALSE,fileEncoding = "UTF-8")

row_names = bert_emb_ancient[, 1]
data_matrix = as.matrix(bert_emb_ancient[, -1, drop = FALSE])

# 处理重复行名：对重复项取平均值并保留第一个重复项
unique_names = unique(row_names)
result_matrix = matrix(NA, nrow = length(unique_names), ncol = ncol(data_matrix))
rownames(result_matrix) = unique_names
colnames(result_matrix) = colnames(data_matrix)

for (i in seq_along(unique_names)) {
  name = unique_names[i]
  rows_idx = which(row_names == name)
  if (length(rows_idx) > 1) {
    result_matrix[i, ] = colMeans(data_matrix[rows_idx, , drop = FALSE])
  } else {
    result_matrix[i, ] = as.numeric(data_matrix[rows_idx, ])
  }
}
bert_emb_ancient = as.data.frame(result_matrix)

bert_emb_ancient = bert_emb_ancient[rels_order_ancient_143r,rels_order_ancient_143r]
bert_ancient_array = lowerTriangle(bert_emb_ancient)
#cor_matrix_plot(as.matrix(bert_emb_ancient),c(-1,1))
```

## Spearman Correlation
### modern:123 relationships
```{r}
# ceiling performance
human_cosine_sim_123r_array = lowerTriangle(human_cosine_sim_123r)

model_geo_combine = cbind(human_cosine_sim_123r_array,# ceiling performance
                          bert_modern_array,#bert_modern
                          favee_123r,
                          hpp_123r,
                          pcsdv_123r)
model_geo_cor = cor(model_geo_combine, method = 'spearman')

options(repr.plot.width=12, repr.plot.height=10)
corrplot(as.matrix(model_geo_cor),is.corr=FALSE,
         addCoef.col = "black",
         tl.col="black",tl.cex=1.0,
         col.lim = c(-1,1),
         col = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(n=7,name ="RdBu")))(100))
```

```{r}
png("output_graph/ceiling_performance.png", width = 12, height = 10, units = "in", res = 300)

corrplot(as.matrix(model_geo_cor), is.corr = FALSE,
         addCoef.col = "black",       
         tl.col = "black",            
         tl.cex = 1.0,
         col.lim = c(-1, 1),
         col = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(n = 7, name = "RdBu")))(100))

dev.off()
```

## Permutation test and Confidence intervals
```{r}
# Create the predicted model
geo_list = list()
geo_list[['human']] = human_cosine_sim_123r_array # ceiling performance
geo_list[['modern']] = bert_modern_array
#geo_list[['ancient']] = bert_ancient_array
```

### FAVEE & HPP model
```{r}
pre_123r_model = list()
pre_123r_model[['FAVEE']] = favee_123r_pc_dist
pre_123r_model[['HPP']] = hpp_123r_rdm

#pre_120r_model = list()
#pre_120r_model[['FAVEE']] = favee_120r_pc_dist
#pre_120r_model[['HPP']] = hpp_120r_rdm
     
```

```{r}
permres_full_model <- array(NA,c(2,2,1000)) # 3=human,modern,ancient; 2=favee,hpp
dimnames(permres_full_model) = list(c('human','modern'),c('FAVEE','HPP'))

for (i in 1:1000){
    for (geo in c('human','modern')){
        sel = sample(123)# row/column order randomization index
        pre_model = pre_123r_model
        #if (geo == 'ancient'){
            #sel = sample(120)
            #pre_model = pre_120r_model
        #}
        for (model in names(pre_model)){
            permat <- pre_model[[model]][sel,sel] # randomize predictors
            permres_full_model[geo,model,i]<-cor(lowerTriangle(permat),geo_list[[geo]],
                                                 method = 'spearman')
        }
    }
}
```

```{r}
save(permres_full_model,file = "permutation/permres_full_model.Rdata")
```

```{r}
load("permutation/permres_full_model.Rdata")
```

```{r}
pvals <- matrix(NA,2,2)
rownames(pvals) = c('human','modern')
colnames(pvals) = c('FAVEE','HPP')


for(geo in c('human','modern')){
  for (model in c('FAVEE','HPP')){
    # p-values = prop. of permuted test stats > actual  
    pvals[geo,model] <- mean(permres_full_model[geo,model,] > cvals_full[geo,model]) 
  }
}
sig <- pvals<.025 # two-tailed test, so p = .05/2 = .025
sig
# confidence intrvals from shifted/flipped permtuation null dist.
cis_full <- apply(-permres_full_model,c(1,2),quantile,c(.025,.975)) 
```

```{r}
as.numeric(cis_full)
#cis_full
```

## single dimension
```{r}
permres_single_model <- array(NA,c(2,5,1000)) # 3=human,modern,ancient; 5 single dimensions
dimnames(permres_single_model) = list(c('human','modern'),
                c('Formality','Activeness','Valence','Exchange','Equality'))

for (i in 1:1000){
    for (geo in c('human','modern')){
        sel = sample(123)# row/column order randomization index
        pre_model = pcsds_123r
        #if (geo == 'ancient'){
            #sel = sample(120)
            #pre_model = pcsds_120r
        #}
        for (model in names(pre_model)){
            permat <- pre_model[[model]][sel,sel] # randomize predictors
            permres_single_model[geo,model,i]<-cor(lowerTriangle(permat),geo_list[[geo]],
                                                   method = 'spearman')
        }
    }
}
```

### FAVEE & HPP model
```{r}
#rvalue_interval 
cvals_cis_full = melt(cvals_full)
colnames(cvals_cis_full)[1] = 'geo'
colnames(cvals_cis_full)[2] = 'model'
# add interval
# cvals_cis_full$'lower' = cis_full[seq(1, length(cis_full), by = 2)]
# cvals_cis_full$'upper' = cis_full[seq(2, length(cis_full), by = 2)]
# cvals_cis_full = cvals_cis_full %>% mutate(lower = lower+value,
#                                  upper = upper+value)
cvals_cis_full$model = factor(cvals_cis_full$model,
                        levels = rev(c('FAVEE','HPP')))
cvals_cis_full$geo = factor(cvals_cis_full$geo,
                      levels = c('human','modern','ancient'))

########################################################################
df <- data.frame(geo = character(), model = character(), value = numeric())
permres = permres_full_model
for (geo_name in dimnames(permres)[[1]]) {
  for (model_name in dimnames(permres)[[2]]) {
    temp <- data.frame(
      geo = geo_name, 
      model = model_name, 
      value = permres[geo_name, model_name, ]
    )
    
    df <- bind_rows(df, temp)
  }
}
df$model = factor(df$model,levels = rev(c('FAVEE','HPP')))
df$geo = factor(df$geo,levels = c('human','modern'))
df = df[df$'geo' %in% c('modern'),]
df$'X' = paste(df$'geo',df$'model',sep='_')
df$'X' = factor(df$'X',levels = c('modern_HPP','modern_FAVEE'))
```

```{r}
write.csv(df, 'permutation/favee_hpp.csv')
```

```{r}
geom_hline(yintercept = 0,linetype='dashed',linewidth = 1.5)+
theme_classic()+
#coord_flip()+
theme(axis.title = element_blank(),
      #axis.text.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size=30,color="black"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(size=10,color="black"),
      axis.line = element_line(linetype=1,color="black",size=2),    
      legend.title = element_blank(),
      legend.text = element_text(size=24),
      legend.position = 'bottom'
     )
```
